mainEntity.name: What is PPT to SCORM conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: PPT to SCORM conversion takes your existing PowerPoint deck and transforms it into a fully animated, narrated, assessed, SCORM-ready eLearning course — complete with scenario training, adaptive assessments and personalised learning paths. No scripts or storyboards needed.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to convert a PowerPoint to a SCORM course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Approximately 15 days from upload to delivery. You send your PowerPoint, PDF or Word document on day one; the AI pipeline redesigns, animates and narrates it; human QA reviews every output; and the finished SCORM and MP4 files are delivered by day 15.

mainEntity.name: What does 'zero hallucination' mean in this context?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every element in the finished course — narration, visuals, assessment questions and scenario branches — is derived exclusively from your uploaded source documents. The AI does not invent or improvise content. Instructional designers review the output before delivery for accuracy.

mainEntity.name: What file formats are accepted and delivered?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can upload PowerPoint (PPT/PPTX), PDF or Word documents. The finished course is delivered as SCORM 1.2 and MP4, ready to drop into any LMS. xAPI reporting and LTI integration are also supported.

mainEntity.name: How much does PPT to SCORM conversion cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Essentials package starts at ₹1,50,000 for a 45-minute narrated, animated compliance course with a 20-question assessment bank. The Professional tier ranges from ₹2,50,000 to ₹4,00,000 and adds scenario-based and adaptive assessments, AI avatar narration and brand-matched design. Enterprise pricing is available for multi-course programmes.
